title: Loading data spinner persists and overlaps save button on Fifty Groups theme details screen
description: When navigating to the 'Fifty Groups' theme details, the 'Loading data...' spinner remains visible and overlays the 'Save' button, preventing interaction with it.
steps: Tap on the 'Themes' icon in the bottom navigation bar.
Tap on the three-dot menu icon for the 'Fifty Groups' theme.
Observe the 'Save' button is unresponsive due to the overlaying spinner.
actual: The 'Loading data...' spinner remains visible on the 'Fifty Groups' theme details screen, obscuring the 'Save' button and making it unusable.
expected: The 'Loading data...' spinner should disappear once the data is loaded, allowing the user to interact with the 'Save' button.
